Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 400/2021

Dear Mr. Desai,

Thank you for meeting us on 13 January 2022 about your dispute with Konark Traders. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Chennai.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Chennai
